_about: Icicles (tsurara) on the roofs' low eaves in winter (IcicleRules). Outdoors only, while at least min_cover of snow lies (the roofs carry snow from there: SnowLayer.top_amount). Their length (0..1 of eave.max) grows over the winter by grow.curve (day of the season -> share; long by mid-winter, shorter again as late winter softens), a little longer with more snow lying (cover_bonus x cover). On a sunny day they melt back round midday by melt: the share lost ramps up from hours[0] to hours[1], holds to hours[2] and freezes back by hours[3]. While melting they drip (drip: looks and hours). Each eave's icicles come from a hash of its ends: gaps between gap[0] and gap[1] units, a skip share left bare, each one's own length between length[0] and 1 (a long share of them always full), its own width. flat: the flat view's 1-2 px strips under the painted roofs' bottom eave (gaps and length in pixels; every one 2 px wide in its top row, the shaded right pixel flat_rim, so it reads on the snow below; wide_from and longer ones 2 px down half their length).
